versions.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single character approval image, intended as a clean image-to-3D reference only AFTER the art director approves it.
Input image: supplied bedroom triptych is the visual reference. Transform its door-peeking angular cat creature into a full-body isolated character study. Preserve the reference's handmade angular cat identity, broad triangular patchwork face, irregular triangular ears, large unequal round eyes with black pupils and one faded ochre iris, quiet unsettling expression.
Composition: one character only, complete head ears feet and short crooked tail visible, near-frontal view with a subtle 10-degree turn, upright neutral stance with arms separated slightly from torso and feet separated. Centered, generous margins, plain light warm-gray background. No scene, no door, no typography, no collage or multiple views.
Proportions: oversized polygonal cat head about one quarter of total height, slender elongated neck and torso, long thin angular limbs, modest small paws. Small short crooked tail ending around knee level, not dragging across floor.
Materials: unmistakably dry, rough, fully matte handmade paper and worn fabric collage bonded over angular solid form; large mismatched faded beige, dusty gray, muted taupe and washed pink polygon patches; subtle paper grain, rubbed edges, occasional fine seams, flat painted eyes. Preserve broad low-poly planes and restrained low-resolution texture character from the reference. Surface must read as porous paper/fabric, NOT leather, polished wood, metal, plastic, ceramic, rubber, fluffy plush or glossy PBR. No shiny specular highlights or reflective eye domes.
Lighting: neutral broad soft diffuse studio illumination, balanced exposure so all materials can be judged, small soft ground shadow only. No dramatic darkness, flashlight, VHS effects, bloom, cinematic color grading or baked dark shadows.
Mood: quietly uncanny watchful homemade cat, closed small mouth, no fangs, no claws, no gore. This is an art approval study; do not include any interface or labels.
versions.review: 偏怪萌，用户要求更诡异、掉 san。

versions.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Edit the supplied cat character approval image into a much more uncanny and psychologically disturbing design, suitable for a quiet door-peeking entity in an old-house horror game. Keep a single complete isolated character on plain pale warm-gray background with diffuse neutral light, all feet ears and short tail visible. Keep the same dry matte worn paper/fabric collage, faded gray dusty pink dirty cream palette, clear low-poly geometry and asymmetric eye colors. Change proportions and behavior substantially: remove all cute toy mascot appeal. Make the body abnormally tall and narrow, about 4.5 heads high, long thin limbs, shoulders sloping and subtly uneven, torso slightly bowed forward as if patiently listening. Thin long neck emerges visibly off-center from beneath the broad angular cat skull. Head tilts about 25 degrees while body stays vertical, anatomically unsettling but structurally coherent. One forearm hangs just slightly too low; simple long tapering fingers hang still, no sharp claws, no human muscular anatomy. Long narrow feet flat on the floor.
Face is the focal point: the familiar triangular cat face has radically unequal eye socket sizes and subtly misaligned eye level; large dark eye sockets with small flat off-center ochre paper iris discs and dark pupils, eyes looking straight at the viewer with disquieting fixation. No sparkling catchlights, no glossy glass, no friendly brows, no smile; tiny tightly closed seam mouth almost disappears into collage. Facial geometry seems subtly incorrectly assembled, one cheek flatter and the opposite cheek protrudes. Large angular ears irregular, one compressed/folded. Use large dry torn polygon patches, frayed paper edges, faint dirty water stains, restrained cracks at neck joins; no fluffy fur or padded plush volume. The effect is an inert handmade thing that appears aware of the viewer.
Single character design image for approval before 3D generation. No scene, extra objects, captions, collage panels, VHS overlay, fog, glow, blood, gore, exposed flesh, weapons, monster teeth, exaggerated roaring pose. Keep shape readable with even illumination; unease must come from proportion, fixed gaze and stillness, not darkness. Portrait framing, generous clear space around full silhouette.
versions.review: 用户已明确认可并要求生成此模型。
